business_problem: One of the biggest challenges FedEx has faced in recent years has been keeping up with fast growth. This acceleration brought new challenges and needs for the organization, especially within Revenue Services. Large amounts of data were becoming difficult to manage, and it was clear that Revenue Services within FedEx was becoming overwhelmed.
solution_summary: FedEx built this solution on Azure Machine Learning, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI. One of the biggest challenges FedEx has faced in recent years has been keeping up with fast growth. This acceleration brought new challenges and needs for the organization, especially within Revenue Services. Azure Machine Learning supports model training, evaluation, and deployment for machine learning workloads. Azure Synapse Analytics models and analyzes enterprise data for reporting, AI, and decision support. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Investing in Azure Synapse Analytics to match company growth The Enterprise Business Strategies team wanted to lean into data modelling to better understand their breadth of data and make more informed decisions across the Revenue Services division. Operational data is collected from line-of-business systems, modeled in Azure Synapse Analytics before Power BI dashboards surface insights to business users.
